```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(pheatmap)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(clustree)
library(DT)
library(grid)
source("funciones.R")
```

# Dataset original

```{r}
merged_rds   <- here::here("Resultados_Algoritmos_v1/original_joinmerged_clustering.rds")
merged <- readRDS(merged_rds)

#clusters como factor

merged$Leiden_original_res0.8 <- as.factor(merged$Leiden_original_res0.8)
merged$Leiden_original_res1 <- as.factor(merged$Leiden_original_res1)
merged$Leiden_original_res1.2 <- as.factor(merged$Leiden_original_res1.2)

#ruta marcadores
base_markers <- here::here("Resultados_Algoritmos_v1/Resultados_original")
#ruta salida plots
base_salida <- file.path(base_markers, paste0("Plots"))
```

## Clustree - Etiquetas originales

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
# Extraemos solo esa parte de la metadata
col_clusters <- c("Leiden_original_res0.8", 
                     "Leiden_original_res1", 
                     "Leiden_original_res1.2")

merged_clust <- merged@meta.data[, col_clusters]
conteo_k <- merged_clust %>% 
  summarise(across(all_of(col_clusters), n_distinct))

print(conteo_k)

plot_clustree <- clustree(merged_clust, prefix = "Leiden_original_res", layout = "sugiyama") +
  labs(title = "Árbol de Clustering: Leiden",
       color = "Resolución")
print(plot_clustree)

ruta_clustree_original <- file.path(base_salida, paste0("Leiden_Clustree_etiquetas_originales.png"))
ggsave(filename = ruta_clustree_original, 
       plot = plot_clustree, 
       width = 10, 
       height = 6, 
       dpi = 300, 
       bg = "white")  
```

## UMAP Paciente

```{r}

DimPlot(merged, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

## Resolución 0.8

### UMAP

```{r}
col_cluster <- 'Leiden_original_res0.8'
plot_umap_ist(merged, col_cluster)

ruta_umap_original <- file.path(base_salida, paste0(col_cluster, "_umap1.png"))
guardar_umap_ist(merged, col_cluster, ruta_umap_original)
```

### Cantidad de células por tipo

```{r}
tabla_conteos_ist(merged, col_cluster)
```

### Marcadores por cluster

```{r}
ruta_markers <- file.path(base_markers, paste0("Marcadores_", col_cluster, ".txt"))
resumen_marcadores_ist(ruta_markers)
```

### Perfil

```{r}
#| out-width: "80%"  # Usa porcentajes de la pantalla

ruta_heatmap <- file.path(base_salida, paste0(col_cluster, "_heatmap.png"))

perfil_heatmap <- perfil_heatmap_ist(merged, col_cluster,
                   titulo = paste("Perfil de expresión promedio -", col_cluster),
                   ruta_archivo = ruta_heatmap)

knitr::include_graphics(ruta_heatmap)
```

### Marcador PanCK

```{r}
boxplots_panck_ist(merged, col_cluster)

ruta_panck <- file.path(base_salida, paste0(col_cluster, "_panck.png"))
guardar_panck_ist(merged, col_cluster, ruta_panck)
```

### UMAP con todos los labels

```{r}
mapa_grupos <- c(
  "1" = "Tumor",
  "2" = "Tumor",
  "3" = "Estroma",
  "4" = "Linf. T",
  "5" = "Estroma",
  "6" = "Tumor",
  "7" = "Mac", #marcadores no especificos

  "21" = "NK"
)

nueva_col <- 'Leiden_original_res0.8_grupo'

ruta_umap_original <- file.path(base_salida, paste0(nueva_col, "_umap1.png"))
guardar_umap_ist(merged, nueva_col, ruta_umap_original)
```


## Clustree - Post Etiquetas

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
merged$Leiden_grupo_res0.8  <- as.character(merged$Leiden_original_res0.8_grupo)
merged$Leiden_grupo_res1  <- as.character(merged$Leiden_original_res1_grupo)
merged$Leiden_grupo_res1.2 <- as.character(merged$Leiden_original_res1.2_grupo)

merged_clust <- merged@meta.data[, c("Leiden_grupo_res0.8", "Leiden_grupo_res1", "Leiden_grupo_res1.2")]
conteo_k <- merged_clust %>% 
  summarise(across(all_of(c("Leiden_grupo_res0.8", "Leiden_grupo_res1", "Leiden_grupo_res1.2")), n_distinct))
print(conteo_k)

plot_clustree_grupos <- clustree(merged, prefix = "Leiden_grupo_res", layout = "sugiyama", prop_filter = 0.05) +
  labs(title = "Leiden",
       subtitle = "Resoluciones = 0.8, 1, 1.2",
       color = "Resolución")

print(plot_clustree_grupos)

ruta_clustree_grupos <- file.path(base_salida, paste0("Leiden_original_clustree_etiquetas_final.png"))
ggsave(filename = ruta_clustree_grupos, 
       plot = plot_clustree_grupos, 
       width = 10, 
       height = 8, 
       dpi = 300, 
       bg = "white") 
```

## Clustree - Post Etiquetas

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
merged_thin75$Leiden_grupo_res0.8  <- as.character(merged_thin75$Leiden_thin_75_res0.8_grupo)

merged_thin75$Leiden_grupo_res1  <- as.character(merged_thin75$Leiden_thin_75_res1_grupo)

merged_thin75$Leiden_grupo_res1.2 <- as.character(merged_thin75$Leiden_thin_75_res1.2_grupo)

merged_clust <- merged_thin75@meta.data[, c("Leiden_grupo_res0.8", "Leiden_grupo_res1", "Leiden_grupo_res1.2")]
conteo_k <- merged_clust %>% 
  summarise(across(all_of(c("Leiden_grupo_res0.8", "Leiden_grupo_res1", "Leiden_grupo_res1.2")), n_distinct))
print(conteo_k)

plot_clustree_grupos <- clustree(merged_thin75, prefix = "Leiden_grupo_res", layout = "sugiyama",  prop_filter = 0.05) +
  labs(title = "Árbol de Clustering: Grupos Consolidados",
       subtitle = "Resoluciones = 0.8, 1, 1.2",
       color = "Resolución")

print(plot_clustree_grupos)

ruta_clustree_grupos <- file.path(base_salida, paste0("Leiden_thin_75_clustree_etiquetas_final.png"))

       plot = plot_clustree_grupos,

       bg = "white")
```

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
                              k_val = '0.8')

       width = 10,
```

# Fov

```{r mapas-espaciales,results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# 1. Definimos las columnas y LA NUEVA RUTA DE GUARDADO
obj_spat <- merged
groupbys <- c("Leiden_original_res1.2_grupo")
col_cluster <- paleta_maestra
col_muestra <- "orig.ident"
col_fov <- "fov"

# --- AJUSTE DE RUTA ---
dir_spatial <- here::here("Resultados_Algoritmos_v1/spatial_maps/Leiden")
if (!dir.exists(dir_spatial)) dir.create(dir_spatial, recursive = TRUE)

# Inicializar lista para guardar
plots_by_groupby_fov <- list()
pad_frac <- 0.05

# 2. Generación de Gráficos
for (img in Images(obj_spat)) {
  
  coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(obj_spat[[img]])
  if (!"cell" %in% colnames(coords)) coords$cell <- rownames(coords)
  
  md <- obj_spat@meta.data
  md_img <- md[rownames(md) %in% coords$cell, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(md_img) == 0) next
  
  muestras <- unique(md_img[[col_muestra]])
  
  for (muestra in muestras) {
    md_muestra <- md_img[md_img[[col_muestra]] == muestra, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # ORDENAMOS los FOV numéricamente (1, 2, 3... 10, 11)
    fovs <- sort(unique(as.numeric(md_muestra[[col_fov]]))) 
    
    for (fov_id in fovs) {
      cells <- rownames(md_muestra)[md_muestra[[col_fov]] == fov_id]
      cells <- intersect(cells, coords$cell)
      if (length(cells) == 0) next
      
      cc <- coords[coords$cell %in% cells, , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(cc) == 0) next
      
      # Coordenadas
      ylim <- range(cc$x, na.rm = TRUE)
      xlim <- range(cc$y, na.rm = TRUE)
      xpad <- diff(xlim) * pad_frac
      ypad <- diff(ylim) * pad_frac
      
      # Clave única y ordenada
      key <- paste(muestra, "FOV", sprintf("%02d", fov_id), sep = "_")
      
      for (gb in groupbys) {
        if (!gb %in% colnames(md_muestra)) next
        
        etiquetas_plot <- unique(as.character(md_muestra[cells, gb, drop = TRUE]))
        etiquetas_plot <- etiquetas_plot[!is.na(etiquetas_plot)]
        cols_use <- col_cluster[names(col_cluster) %in% etiquetas_plot]
        
        p <- ImageDimPlot(
          obj_spat,
          fov = img,
          group.by = gb,
          axes = FALSE, 
          cells = cells,
          size = 2,
          cols = cols_use
        ) +
          ggtitle(paste0("Muestra: ", muestra, " | FOV: ", fov_id))
        
        # Corrección del volteo de coordenadas
        if (!is.null(p$data)) p$data <- transform(p$data, x = y, y = x)
        
        p <- p + 
          coord_fixed(
            ratio = 1,
            xlim = c(ylim[1] - ypad, ylim[2] + ypad),
            ylim = c(xlim[1] - xpad, xlim[2] + xpad),
            expand = FALSE
          ) + 
          scale_x_continuous(name = NULL, breaks = NULL, labels = NULL) +
          scale_y_continuous(name = NULL, breaks = NULL, labels = NULL) +
          theme_void() + 
          theme(
            plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14, color = "white"),
            panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
            plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
            legend.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
            legend.key = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
            legend.text = element_text(color = "white", size = 10),
            legend.title = element_text(color = "white", size = 12, face = "bold"),
            legend.position = "right",
            legend.justification = "center", 
            legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = -20)
          ) +
          guides(fill = guide_legend(
            ncol = 2,
            override.aes = list(size = 4)))
        
        if (is.null(plots_by_groupby_fov[[gb]])) plots_by_groupby_fov[[gb]] <- list()
        plots_by_groupby_fov[[gb]][[key]] <- p
      }
    }
  }
}

# 3. Guardar las imágenes y compilar el HTML
for (gb in names(plots_by_groupby_fov)) {
  keys_ordenadas <- sort(names(plots_by_groupby_fov[[gb]]))
  cat(paste0("\n## Mapas Espaciales - ", gb, "\n\n"))
  
  for (key in keys_ordenadas) {
    # Usamos la nueva ruta estricta
    out_png <- file.path(dir_spatial, paste0(key, ".png"))
    
    ggsave(
      filename = out_png,
      plot = plots_by_groupby_fov[[gb]][[key]],
      width = 8, 
      height = 8, 
      dpi = 300, 
      bg = "black" 
    )
    
    cat(paste0("### ", key, "\n\n"))
    
    # Inyectamos la imagen guardada al HTML de forma compatible
    cat(sprintf("![](%s)\n\n", out_png))
    cat("---\n\n")
  }
}
```
